releases.name: v0.1.0 — Initial Release
releases.body:
First public release of **@qthinker/opencode-colorful-timeline** — an OpenCode
Desktop plugin that brings the TUI's colorful Markdown styling to the GUI
conversation timeline, via one scoped stylesheet.

## Highlights

- TUI-matching Markdown colors in the conversation timeline: headings, bold,
  italic, blockquotes, list markers, and inline code
- `light-dark()` color pairs that follow the current light/dark appearance
- Muted regions stay muted: reasoning parts, tool output, and path inline
  code keep their own colors
- Zero runtime dependencies — one self-contained bundle (~0.7 kB) loaded via
  the plugin's `./gui-experimental` export

## Install

Add the package to your global `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json(c)`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["@qthinker/opencode-colorful-timeline"],
}
```

or install it directly:

```sh
opencode plugin add @qthinker/opencode-colorful-timeline
```

## Notes

- Colors live in `src/tui-colors.css`; see the README for the live-reload
  local development workflow.
- Docs: [English](https://github.com/QThinkerJR/opencode-colorful-timeline#readme)
  | [简体中文](https://github.com/QThinkerJR/opencode-colorful-timeline/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/QThinkerJR/opencode-colorful-timeline/commits/v0.1.0
